durotar_patrol_1: I patrol the highway between Orgrimmar and Razor Hill. The road's clear. The rock shelves either side of it aren't - the armored scorpids are thick this season, and they've started coming down to the verge.
durotar_traveler: Grosk. I walk Durotar because I can't abide walls - Orgrimmar's or anybody's. The nights out here are colder than the days let on, though, and my blanket has given out.
durotar_kid: My father's in the Warsong! I'm going to be too. Watch - this is my sparring stance. No, wait. This one.
durotar_orgrimmar_gate_guard: Outrider, for the Orgrimmar gate - that's it behind me, to the north. I watch the first stretch of the highway, and for three weeks a pack of hyenas has been watching it with me.
durotar_thunder_ridge_scout: Kurr. I watch Thunder Ridge, the gravel basin just north-west of this post. Thunder lizards - slow, and they hit like the ground opening under you. Lately something up there has been driving them down toward the road.
durotar_skull_rock_patrol: My post is Skull Rock, the cave in the cliffs just east of here. The Burning Blade has dug into it. I count their torches every night, and every night there are more.
durotar_goblin_prospector: Fitz. Gazlowe's cousin - yes, that Gazlowe, the one in Ratchet with the money. I'm prospecting Durotar on my own account. There's a fortune in this dirt. I've narrowed it down to 'somewhere'.
durotar_rocktusk_scout: Borka. The Watchful, they call me. I keep an eye on Rocktusk Farm, south-west of here - quilboar, and more of them every season - and on whatever else moves along the valley road.
durotar_skeleton_marker: [A wagon-driver's bones, laid out the way a man lies down rather than the way he falls. The desert has taken everything else about him.]
durotar_beltelf_merchant: Sylthressa Windmourne. I trade between Razor Hill and the Scuttle Coast, south-east of here. The margins in Durotar are excellent - or they were, until the murlocs started cutting my suppliers' nets.
durotar_human_prisoner_convert: Wyll Marrow. I was Alliance once, then a prisoner, and now I'm a man who stayed. I ride with the Razor Hill patrols. The Kolkar raid the Barrens road from their crag to the south-west, and I've buried friends over it.
durotar_vot_road_traveler: Grekka. I'm walking my nephew down to the Valley of Trials - it's through the gateway just south of here. His first trial. The road past Rocktusk Farm has Razormane on it, and nervous doesn't cover it.
durotar_razorhill_road_merchant: Bok. I sell on the highway north of Razor Hill - the town's just down the road behind me. The road's clear, mostly, apart from the quilboar who've started charging a toll they're calling a tax.
durotar_tiragarde_scout: Watchwarden Kelgrim. That ruin on the coast south-east of here is Tiragarde Keep - Kul Tiras marines who never went home. They're quiet today. That has never once meant they're safe.
durotar_burning_blade_warden: Bloodwarden Ashgrym. I've hunted the Burning Blade since before this was a posting. They hold Skull Rock, the cave east of here, and they do not die easily. I have been trying for a long time.
